questions.implements: Does the diff implement what the user asked for, and add or change a test that checks it? Judge the code in the diff, not the answer.

judge.reason: The diff implements SHOP-57 and adds tests that check it. VolumeDiscount takes 5% off a line only when that line has 10 or more units, and integer division rounds it down to the cent. PlaceOrder adds up the volume discount across the cart lines. PriceWithVolume takes the volume discount off first, applies any discount code to the reduced subtotal, and caps the combined discount at 50% of the original subtotal. The tests cover the threshold, rounding down, a code applied after the volume discount, and the combined cap. The expected values are correct when checked by hand. In the checkout test, two lines of 190 give 9 + 9 = 18 off, then 10% of 362 gives 36, for 54 in total. In the pricing test, 500 + 950 = 1,450, and the cap holds the 50% code case at 5,000.

finalMessage:
Implemented SHOP-57. Checkout now applies a 5% discount to each cart line with at least 10 units, rounds each line’s discount down to the cent, applies any discount code to the reduced subtotal, and caps the combined discount at 50% of the original subtotal.
